title: Triangle Shirtwaist Factory fire kills 146 workers
summary: A fire in a garment factory in Manhattan killed 146 workers, mostly young immigrant women, many of whom were trapped by locked doors or jumped to their deaths.
reason: Exits were locked to prevent theft and breaks, and the building lacked adequate fire escapes and sprinklers.
significance: It led to major workplace safety laws and strengthened the American labor movement.
place: Asch Building, New York City, United States
